data.title: 伊卡洛斯 · 屋顶望远镜的第一颗星
data.description: 薄暮过去，伊卡洛斯才把目镜往下调了一格。她穿着银色战甲，左眼的护目片露在侧光里，右手慢慢转动焦轮。屋顶风很小，她把翅膀拢起，免得擦到脚架。
data.action: 低头对准目镜，右手轻转焦轮
data.lighting: 余晖照在银甲边缘，仪表轻光
data.camera: 侧前方中近景，左眼护目片可见
data.promptProse: On the rooftop at the start of night, Ikaros leans toward the eyepiece of a tripod telescope. In her silver armor and left-eye combat visor, she turns the focus wheel with one hand. Her folded wings hang clear of the tripod, and the last strip of twilight outlines her breastplate.
data.animaCaption: Her visor remains visible beside the eyepiece while one hand turns the telescope’s focus wheel.
